categories.main_business_segments: Electric Connector Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of micro electrical connectors and interconnection system products, POGOPIN products, and PCB flexible boards. Its key product lines include micro RF connectors, electromagnetic compatibility components, soft boards, automotive connectors, and other connector products such as 5G antennas and coaxial connectors. The company serves major sectors including consumer electronics (especially smartphones), automotive electronics (including new energy vehicles), industrial control, and emerging smart devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced micro RF connector design and manufacturing technologies, including high-precision mold processing with sub-2 micron accuracy, automated assembly equipment development, and precision stamping and injection molding. It emphasizes high-frequency, high-speed, and miniaturized connector technologies, including LCP materials and BTB (board-to-board) connectors. The production process is order-driven with ERP-managed supply chain and quality control systems, and the company continuously upgrades its manufacturing automation and precision capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global smartphone brands such as Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung, Honor, ZTE, and Huawei, as well as major domestic automotive manufacturers like Geely, Great Wall, BYD, Changan, Chery, and Li Auto. The company also serves Tier 1 automotive suppliers, IC design firms, and customers in industrial control, AI servers, and wearable devices. Its markets span consumer electronics, automotive electronics (especially new energy vehicles and intelligent driving systems), and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with major production and sales concentrated in the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta regions. It has expanded operations to inland regions and overseas through subsidiaries in Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, and other locations. The domestic market accounts for over 85% of revenue, with international sales growing steadily. China is the largest market, representing over 30% of the global connector market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Electric Connector Technology Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of electronic connectors and interconnection systems. It supplies critical components to downstream OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in consumer electronics and automotive sectors. The company also engages in upstream activities such as mold design and development of automated production equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-frequency, high-speed, and miniaturized connectors, especially for 5G millimeter-wave applications, automotive Ethernet, and AI-related products. It invests heavily in developing new BTB products, RF connectors for millimeter-wave 5G, and automotive connectors supporting intelligent driving and new energy vehicles. The firm aims to enhance manufacturing automation, precision mold technology, and expand its product portfolio to include integrated modular solutions. Collaboration with global chip manufacturers and 5G research institutions is a key focus.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of connectors, interconnection systems, and related electronic components. The company operates a direct sales model with a strong sales team engaging major domestic and international customers. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings. The revenue is recognized mainly at the point of product delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global connector leaders such as TE Connectivity, Amphenol, Molex, Rosenberger, and Japanese firms like Hirose and Yazaki. Domestically, it faces competition from emerging Chinese connector manufacturers but holds a leading position in micro RF connectors and automotive connectors. It is recognized as a top-tier domestic supplier with growing international competitiveness, especially in 5G and automotive sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.66 billion, a 48.97% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 622 million, up 74.73%. Total assets reached RMB 7.41 billion, growing 17.8% from the previous year. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding automotive connector sales and recovery in consumer electronics. R&D investment increased to RMB 398 million, representing 8.53% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, high performance, and precision manufacturing of micro RF connectors and interconnection systems, matching international first-tier standards. Its products support high-frequency, high-speed data transmission with miniaturization and integration, catering to advanced 5G, AI, and automotive intelligent driving applications. Strong R&D capabilities, automated production, and close collaboration with leading customers provide competitive advantages. The firm also highlights its comprehensive quality management and environmental compliance as part of its value proposition.
